item.title: Entertainment vs. reality: How media glamorizes opioids and warps teens’ perception
item.description: Getty Images Opioids are often shown in movies, music, and social media as party drugs, symbols of fun, rebellion, or a carefree lifestyle. Instead of highlighting the real dangers of addiction, withdrawal or overdose, entertainment culture turns powerful and deadly substances into aesthetic props. item.title: Where hope has fur: The role of animals in opioid addiction recovery
item.description: Getty Images A wagging tail, gentle nudge, or steady breath of a furry friend can seem simple, but research proves that these small moments of connection can aid recovery in people recovering from Opioid Use Disorder (OUD).
